subject.title: feat(claude): add claude-bridge app-server harness extension

question: Should OpenClaw own and bundle a Claude app-server harness, or require this optional runtime to remain an externally maintained plugin?
rationale: The patch creates a large new runtime, dependency, credential, state, command, and configuration surface whose permanent ownership cannot be inferred from implementation quality alone.

options.title: External plugin
options.body: Keep the harness in the contributor-owned plugin repository and merge only generic SDK seams that external app-server harnesses demonstrably need.

options.title: Bundled harness
options.body: Sponsor the harness in OpenClaw after assuming package provenance, security review, SQLite migration, release, and long-term maintenance ownership.

recommendation.title: External plugin
recommendation.body: Keep the harness in the contributor-owned plugin repository and merge only generic SDK seams that external app-server harnesses demonstrably need.

likelyOwner.reason: Current-main history shows direct ownership of the Codex harness precedent and substantial Anthropic plugin work.
